hooks.command:
exec sh -c 'case "$OSTYPE" in msys*|cygwin*) c="py python3 python";; *) c="python3";; esac; for p in $c; do w=$(command -v "$p") || continue; case "$w" in *WindowsApps*) continue;; esac; if [ "$p" = py ]; then exec py -3 -I "$0" "$1"; fi; exec "$p" -I "$0" "$1"; done; exit 0' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/coach_hook.py" before
foreach ($n in 'py', 'python3', 'python') { $c = Get-Command $n -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Source -notlike '*\WindowsApps\*' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($c) { if ($n -eq 'py') { & $c.Source -3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/coach_hook.py" before } else { & $c.Source -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/coach_hook.py" before }; exit 0 } }; exit 0
